prose: The stars are your tendency, not your destiny. Dominique Cordivari of EpiAstrology joins InnerVerse to discuss how to use astrology to improve wellness. Similar to epigenetics, medical astrology can be utilized to enhance our strengths and compensate for our challenges. Tune in to learn how Dominique provides coaching to help maximize our cosmic potential as fractals of Source, with customized crystals, homeopathic cell salts, and other holistic interventions. Break away with fatalistic astro-forecasts and harness your horoscope for your highest good!
